scope: Internal process-local retained firmware job and worker/shutdown supervision. Private stores and MockBackend only; no product updater route, production daemon, native GUI, hardware or host D-Bus execution.
implementation: One retained job per IpcServerImpl process scope: cloned status/progress/cancel/completion observers; wait can be repeated after the first observer is dropped. Report is retained in a completion watch.
Registry lock serializes begin and shutdown. Runtime, registry and manager/store scope are checked before admission seal. Empty shutdown seals registry only, not ordinary admission.
Shutdown explicitly cancels then awaits retained completion; dropping a shutdown waiter does not abort the supervisor. Main retains the typed server and joins firmware before manager shutdown.

Supervisor owns the worker JoinHandle. Worker panic/cancellation produces Unknown after staging close, manager root join and checked tracked cleanup drain. One-shot maintenance recovery authority holds no active count during normal worker execution.

Staging cleanup panic still stops manager and reports cleanup unconfirmed. Lost supervisor completion is an explicit unconfirmed error. No automatic unseal, replay, restore, retry or guard/journal removal.

scenarios: drop observer, reattach and wait for full transfer
shutdown before hold, NotStarted without arm
shutdown after hold, Unknown with guard and zero chunks

checks.native_gui: not run; no frontend/native application source change

new_normal_coverage: Recovery authority does not hold the normal drain count; explicit cleanup lease is counted only after resume. Gate remains sealed.

Injected worker panic with handed-off original actor and EffectsPossible marker: Unknown report, root teardown receipt complete, ordinary map empty, raw journal unchanged and settings guard preserved, tracked count zero.
Shutdown waiter dropped while pending: explicit cancel retained, observer reattachment and repeated wait/shutdown preserve terminal diagnostic.
Empty shutdown retains sealed registry while ordinary admission remains open.
limits: Process-local registry is not durable job/status recovery across daemon restart.
No product JSON-RPC/Tauri Inspect/Apply/status UI or EN/RU updater workflow yet.
Extended power/panic/blocked-I/O/cleanup failure matrix and deadline policy remain. Synchronous HID writes cannot be force-interrupted.
Reconnect probe, qualified guard/journal resolution, restoration and serial-less/missed-reset policy are not integrated.
AwaitingReconnect is not firmware success, installed-image proof or hardware qualification.
